Rank 02 - Service

Salon Serial and Booking System

People hate arriving at a salon and not knowing how many serials are ahead. A QR/public serial page solves a real-life irritation.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 7,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 350Recommended monthly charge

BDT 350/month is practical because the product is customer-facing and saves daily owner time. Keep BDT 250 only for annual prepaid.

9.5Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 7,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 350Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 11,200,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Start with 1,000 salons in Dhaka, Chattogram, Sylhet, district towns, and bazar clusters. Public map data already shows about 9,570 salons before informal shops.

Customers call to ask serial count. Staff answer the same question all day. Walk-ins leave when waiting feels uncertain.

Customers scan QR and see the current serial before coming.

Validation signals

  • Salon count signal is visible in public maps.
  • Every neighborhood has repeat haircut demand.
  • Queue pain is visible to both customer and owner.
  • QR poster can market the product inside the shop.

MVP modules

  • Public salon serial page
  • Door QR code
  • Add, call, skip, complete serial
  • Optional booking slots
  • Staff-wise service list
  • Daily cash close
  • WhatsApp-ready serial message

Do not build first

  • Do not build a beauty product shop.
  • Do not force online payment first.
  • Do not build a salon social network.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Print 50 demo QR posters.
  • Visit salon clusters.
  • Offer first 20 installs at BDT 5,000 with 6 months prepaid.
  • Measure reduced phone calls and fewer walk-outs.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Staff may forget to update serial.
  • Owners may say notebook is enough.
  • Customers without data may still call.
Mitigations
  • One-tap staff actions.
  • Old-phone wall display mode.
  • One-tap WhatsApp serial share.
